definitions.explanation: The part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline.

examples.japanese: {額|ひたい}に{汗|あせ}をかいている。
{熱|ねつ}があるか{額|ひたい}を{触|さわ}って{確|たし}かめた。
examples.english: I touched their forehead to check if they had a fever.

notes:
USAGE: {額|ひたい} specifically refers to the forehead. Note that 額 can also be read as がく meaning 'amount' or 'frame'.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{額|ひたい}に{汗|あせ}をかく (to sweat on the forehead)
・{額|ひたい}を{触|さわ}る (to touch the forehead)
・{額|ひたい}が{広|ひろ}い (to have a wide forehead)
・{額|ひたい}にしわを{寄|よ}せる (to furrow one's brow)

EXPRESSIONS:
・{額|ひたい}に{汗|あせ}して{働|はたら}く (to work hard, lit. 'work with sweat on one's brow')
・{猫|ねこ}の{額|ひたい} (a tiny space, lit. 'a cat's forehead')

BODY PARTS:
・{頭|あたま} - head
・{顔|かお} - face
・{眉毛|まゆげ} - eyebrow
・{目|め} - eye

NOTE: The kanji 額 is read as ひたい for 'forehead' but がく for 'amount' ({金額|きんがく}) or 'frame' ({額縁|がくぶち}).
